purpose: Workflow references for safe ideation, review, furnishing, and presentation.
policy: These patterns improve interaction and presentation; they are not geometry, code, permit, or professional-review authority.

patterns.bestFor: Turning a detailed natural-language description into a structured brief.
patterns.safeAction: Extract dimensions, room uses, occupancy, access intent, adjacency intent, style, and requested outputs into a reviewable brief.
patterns.mustNotDo: Do not turn generated prose or an attractive image directly into authoritative walls, doors, routes, or stairs.

patterns.bestFor: Exploring furniture arrangements and coloured 2D/3D presentation.
patterns.safeAction: Generate presentation candidates only from validated rooms, scaled assets, route widths, door swings, and clearance envelopes.
patterns.mustNotDo: Do not let furniture, materials, lighting, or a render hide a blocker or mutate authoritative geometry.

patterns.bestFor: Site context, building-scale modelling, and feasibility review.
patterns.safeAction: Store north, frontage, setbacks, access points, levels, site assumptions, and rule-pack evidence as explicit inputs.
patterns.mustNotDo: Do not convert a product claim or automated score into a local-code, permit, or construction approval.

patterns.bestFor: Capturing an existing plan or space from photographs or images.
patterns.safeAction: Create an assisted-recognition queue with scale evidence, confidence, source provenance, and manual confirmation before promotion.
patterns.mustNotDo: Do not silently promote image recognition into measured, editable, or issue-ready geometry.

patterns.bestFor: Plans, sections, elevations, and architectural model workflows.
patterns.safeAction: Keep object IDs, levels, openings, dimensions, and validation provenance synchronized across every view and exchange.
patterns.mustNotDo: Do not accept a section or elevation that is disconnected from the canonical model revision.

patterns.bestFor: Live dimensions and scaled floor-plan review.
patterns.safeAction: Use live dimensions as an explainable review aid and rerun topology, clearance, and rule-pack checks after edits.
patterns.mustNotDo: Do not treat a millimetre-accuracy claim as evidence of jurisdictional compliance or professional sign-off.
